propositions: Measurements taken under broader privilege than production (wildcard IAM identity, simulator without from-instance verification) cannot fail for the reasons that matter and yield structurally unverifiable evidence.

Plan-review and completion-verifier cannot audit world-grounded measurements: plan-review runs before evidence exists, completion-verifier accepts operator-attested evidence by design; no current gate observes live cloud state and nothing should.

Assertions of unchanged behaviour across substrate/route/provider swaps without citation of the resolution path that would make them true are invisible to review, making scope discipline itself a camouflage for defects.

Four-field measurement-provenance text records (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) must be deterministically enforced in [operator-attested] criteria, enabling repo-grounded contradictions without re-running world measurements.

Operationally-attested evidence lacking measurable provenance must be flagged by deterministic check (not LLM) to mirror DET-first doctrine and prevent simulator/live-call equivalence from masking authorization differences.

Evidence is only as good as its ability to have produced the opposite outcome for the specific reason under investigation; swapping one instrument for another does not establish that capability without explicit verification.
